sessionFrame: Every session starts with a five-minute brisk warm-up walk and ends with a five-minute cool-down walk — both are already counted in the session times.

weeks.title: Off the couch
weeks.coachNote: Slower than feels sensible is exactly right. If you can't say a full sentence out loud mid-run, ease off — this plan works at any speed.

sessions.title: First strides
sessions.workout: Run 1 min / walk 90 sec — repeat × 8

sessions.title: Same again, smoother
sessions.workout: Run 1 min / walk 90 sec — repeat × 8

sessions.title: Finding a rhythm
sessions.workout: Run 1 min / walk 90 sec — repeat × 8

weeks.title: Stretch the run
weeks.coachNote: Legs may grumble after week one — that's adaptation, not injury. Keep the walking breaks brisk and shake your arms loose between runs.

sessions.title: Ninety-second club
sessions.workout: Run 90 sec / walk 2 min — repeat × 6

sessions.title: Steady, not speedy
sessions.workout: Run 90 sec / walk 2 min — repeat × 6

sessions.title: Comfortable is the goal
sessions.workout: Run 90 sec / walk 2 min — repeat × 6

weeks.title: Three-minute mind
weeks.coachNote: Three minutes sounds long until you've done it once. Split it in your head: settle in the first minute, cruise the second, count the third one down.

sessions.title: Meet the three-minute run
sessions.workout: Run 90 sec · walk 90 sec · run 3 min · walk 3 min — repeat × 2

sessions.title: Trust the walk breaks
sessions.workout: Run 90 sec · walk 90 sec · run 3 min · walk 3 min — repeat × 2

sessions.title: Three minutes, no drama
sessions.workout: Run 90 sec · walk 90 sec · run 3 min · walk 3 min — repeat × 2

weeks.title: Five in a row
weeks.coachNote: This is the week most people quietly realise they've become runners. Protect your rest days — they are where the fitness actually happens.

sessions.title: The five-minute wall
sessions.workout: Run 3 min · walk 90 sec · run 5 min · walk 2½ min · run 3 min · walk 90 sec · run 5 min

sessions.title: Wall? What wall?
sessions.workout: Run 3 min · walk 90 sec · run 5 min · walk 2½ min · run 3 min · walk 90 sec · run 5 min

sessions.title: Five feels normal
sessions.workout: Run 3 min · walk 90 sec · run 5 min · walk 2½ min · run 3 min · walk 90 sec · run 5 min

weeks.title: The twenty-minute door
weeks.coachNote: Session three is the famous one — twenty minutes without a walking break. Everyone panics about it; nearly everyone does it. Go embarrassingly slow and let the door swing open.

sessions.title: Three fives
sessions.workout: Run 5 min · walk 3 min · run 5 min · walk 3 min · run 5 min

sessions.title: Two eights
sessions.workout: Run 8 min · walk 5 min · run 8 min

sessions.title: The twenty-minute run
sessions.workout: Run 20 min with no walking breaks

weeks.title: Past the door
weeks.coachNote: After the twenty-minute run, intervals feel almost gentle again. Enjoy them — this week quietly builds the base for running every session without breaks.

sessions.title: Back to intervals
sessions.workout: Run 5 min · walk 3 min · run 8 min · walk 3 min · run 5 min

sessions.title: Ten and ten
sessions.workout: Run 10 min · walk 3 min · run 10 min

sessions.title: Twenty-two, straight through
sessions.workout: Run 22 min with no walking breaks

weeks.title: All running now
weeks.coachNote: The same run three times: twenty-five minutes, easy. Change the route, not the effort — mild boredom is a sign the engine is getting stronger.

sessions.title: Twenty-five, easy does it
sessions.workout: Run 25 min at a chatty, conversational pace

sessions.title: New route, same legs
sessions.workout: Run 25 min somewhere you have never run before

sessions.title: Cruise control
sessions.workout: Run 25 min at a chatty, conversational pace

weeks.title: Almost there
weeks.coachNote: Twenty-eight minutes is 5K territory for plenty of runners already. Keep the pace honest, keep the bedtime early, and let session two teach you what a strong finish feels like.

sessions.title: Twenty-eight minutes
sessions.workout: Run 28 min steady

sessions.title: Practice the strong finish
sessions.workout: Run 28 min — easy start, brisk final 5 min

sessions.title: Last one before race week
sessions.workout: Run 28 min steady

weeks.title: Race week
weeks.coachNote: Nothing new this week: no new shoes, no new breakfast, no hero pace on day one. Then go run your 5K — and message me from the finish line.

sessions.title: Thirty, relaxed
sessions.workout: Run 30 min, relaxed and easy

sessions.title: Dress rehearsal
sessions.workout: Run 30 min — same shoes, route and breakfast as race day

sessions.title: Graduation day: your 5K
sessions.workout: Run 5K — about 30 min. You are a runner now
